12	from wakil.ui.console import (
13	    console,

31	WORKSPACE_HELP = (
32	    "Workspace directory or registered workspace name "
33	    "(defaults to the current directory, searching upward)."
34	)

36	app = typer.Typer(
37	    name="wakil",

39	    no_args_is_help=True,

43	)

48	app.add_typer(git_app, name="git")
49	memory_app = typer.Typer(

51	)
52	app.add_typer(memory_app, name="memory")
53	schema_app = typer.Typer(

56	app.add_typer(schema_app, name="schema")
57	skills_app = typer.Typer(
58	    help="Discover, inspect, and validate skills.", no_args_is_help=True
59	)
60	app.add_typer(skills_app, name="skills")

63	@app.callback()
64	def main(
65	    ctx: typer.Context,
66	    workspace: Annotated[
67	        str | None,
68	        typer.Option(
69	            "--workspace", "-w", envvar="WAKIL_WORKSPACE", help=WORKSPACE_HELP
70	        ),
71	    ] = None,
72	) -> None:
73	    """Local-first agent for a personal Markdown knowledge base."""
74	    ctx.obj = workspace
75	
76	
77	def _resolve_workspace(ctx: typer.Context) -> Path:
78	    """Resolve -w/--workspace (path or registered name) to an initialized root."""
79	    value: str | None = ctx.obj
80	    if value is None:
81	        root = find_workspace_root(Path.cwd())
82	        if root is None:
83	            console.print(
84	                "[red]No wakil workspace found in the current directory.[/red] "
85	                "Run [bold]wakil init <path>[/bold] first, or pass "
86	                "[bold]-w <path-or-name>[/bold]."
87	            )
88	            raise typer.Exit(code=1)
89	        return root
90	
91	    candidate = Path(value).expanduser()
92	    if candidate.is_dir():
93	        root = find_workspace_root(candidate)
94	        if root is None:
95	            console.print(
96	                f"[red]{candidate} is not inside an initialized wakil workspace.[/red] "
97	                "Run [bold]wakil init <path>[/bold] first."
98	            )
99	            raise typer.Exit(code=1)
100	        return root
101	
102	    registered = lookup_workspace(value)
103	    if registered is None:
104	        console.print(
105	            f"[red]Unknown workspace: {value}[/red] — not a directory and not a "
106	            "registered workspace name. Run [bold]wakil init <path>[/bold] to register one."
107	        )
108	        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
109	    if not is_initialized(registered):
110	        console.print(
111	            f"[red]Registered workspace '{value}' points to {registered}, which is no "
112	            "longer initialized.[/red] Re-run [bold]wakil init[/bold] there."
113	        )
114	        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
115	    return registered
116	
117	
118	@app.command()
119	def init(
120	    path: Annotated[
121	        Path, typer.Argument(help="Knowledge-base directory to initialize.")
122	    ] = Path("."),
123	    name: Annotated[
124	        str | None,
125	        typer.Option("--name", help="Workspace name (defaults to directory name)."),
126	    ] = None,
127	) -> None:
128	    """Initialize a knowledge-base workspace and index its Markdown files."""
129	    status, index_result = init_workspace(path, name=name)
130	    register_workspace(status.config.name, status.config.root_path)
131	    console.print(
132	        f"Workspace [bold]{status.config.name}[/bold] ready at {status.config.root_path} "
133	        f"[dim](use -w {status.config.name} from anywhere)[/dim]"
134	    )
135	    print_index_result(index_result)
136	    print_status(status)

139	@app.command()
140	def status(ctx: typer.Context) -> None:
141	    """Show workspace status: notes, git state, QMD availability."""
142	    print_status(get_status(_resolve_workspace(ctx)))
143	
144	
145	@app.command()
146	def index(ctx: typer.Context) -> None:
147	    """Re-index Markdown files into the workspace database."""
148	    _, index_result = init_workspace(_resolve_workspace(ctx))
149	    print_index_result(index_result)

152	@app.command()
153	def search(
154	    ctx: typer.Context,
155	    query: Annotated[str, typer.Argument(help="Free-text search query.")],
156	    limit: Annotated[int, typer.Option("--limit", help="Max results per engine.")] = 10,
157	    mode: Annotated[
158	        str,
159	        typer.Option(
160	            "--mode", help="QMD mode: search (BM25), vsearch (vector), query (hybrid)."
161	        ),
162	    ] = "search",
163	) -> None:
164	    """Search the knowledge base via QMD plus local FTS indexes."""
165	    from wakil.app.search_service import search_workspace
166	    from wakil.app.workspace_service import open_session
167	
168	    root = _resolve_workspace(ctx)
169	    config = WorkspaceConfig.load(root)
170	    with open_session(config) as session:
171	        hits = search_workspace(session, config, query, limit=limit, mode=mode)
172	    print_search_hits(hits, query)
173	    if not config.qmd_enabled:
174	        console.print(
175	            "[dim]QMD not detected; results are from local indexes only.[/dim]"
176	        )
177	
178	
179	@app.command()
180	def query(
181	    ctx: typer.Context,
182	    question: Annotated[
183	        str, typer.Argument(help="Question to answer from the knowledge base.")
184	    ],
185	    limit: Annotated[
186	        int, typer.Option("--limit", help="Max search hits to consider.")
187	    ] = 10,
188	    mode: Annotated[
189	        str,
190	        typer.Option(
191	            "--mode", help="QMD mode: search (BM25), vsearch (vector), query (hybrid)."
192	        ),
193	    ] = "search",
194	) -> None:
195	    """Answer a question with grounded citations from the knowledge base."""
196	    from wakil.app.query_service import run_query
197	    from wakil.llm.client import ModelError, resolve_client
198	
199	    root = _resolve_workspace(ctx)
200	    config = WorkspaceConfig.load(root)
201	    client = resolve_client()
202	    if client is None:
203	        console.print(
204	            "[red]No model provider configured.[/red] Set [bold]ANTHROPIC_API_KEY[/bold] "
205	            "(or OPENAI_API_KEY + WAKIL_MODEL for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint)."
206	        )
207	        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
208	    try:
209	        with console.status(f"Querying with {client.model}..."):
210	            result = run_query(config, question, client, limit=limit, mode=mode)
211	    except ModelError as exc:
212	        console.print(f"[red]Model error:[/red] {exc}")
213	        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from exc
214	    print_query_result(result)

254	    kind: str,
255	    yes: bool,

258	    branch: bool = False,

264	    from wakil.app.git_service import GitServiceError, start_ingest_branch
265	    from wakil.app.ingest_service import IngestError, apply_capture, prepare_capture
266	
267	    root = _resolve_workspace(ctx)
268	    config = WorkspaceConfig.load(root)
269	    if pr:

637	    entity_type: Annotated[
638	        str | None,
639	        typer.Option("--type", help="Migrate only notes of this entity type."),
640	    ] = None,

647	    ] = False,

651	            "--commit", "-c", help="Commit each type's fixes (wakil chore: ...)."
652	        ),

654	) -> None:
655	    """Propose cheap-tier frontmatter fixes and apply them per type on confirm."""
656	    from wakil.app.git_service import GitServiceError, commit_change
657	    from wakil.app.schema_migrate_service import (
658	        MigrateError,
659	        apply_migrations,

663	
664	    root = _resolve_workspace(ctx)

669	    except MigrateError as exc:

671	        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from exc
672	
673	    print_migration_plan(plan)
674	    if plan.total_files == 0:
675	        return
676	    if dry_run:

678	            print_migration_diffs(proposals)
